title: stardelt bundle.yaml
description: The shape of a stardelt bundle.yaml, for editors. Structural only: stardelt bundle validate checks more (that the files exist, that every ${var.x} resolves, that a production target gives runAs), so a file this schema accepts can still be refused by validate.

name.description: the bundle's name: 3 to 40 characters, lower-case letters, digits and dashes

ownerGroup.description: the group that owns every pipeline of the bundle

variables.description: each variable by name, with an optional default and description

default.description: the value a target uses when it sets none

description.description: one sentence on what the variable is

include.description: patterns of the resource files: one pipeline or one stream app per file

files.description: patterns of the files the pipelines read, relative to the bundle directory

migrations.description: the catalog and the SQL files that change tables, run once per target

catalog.description: the catalog the migration ledger lives in

files.description: patterns of the migration files, each named NNN_<words>.sql

requires.description: what the stage must have before the bundle deploys

connections.description: names of the connections the stage must have (names only, never values)

targets.description: one entry per stage: dev, test, prod or any name you choose

mode.description: development deploys dev-<sign-in>-<name> without a schedule; production deploys the file's name with its schedule

variables.description: a value for each variable you want to set for this stage

runAs.description: the pipeline identity a production target runs as: pipeline-<ownerGroup>

drift.description: what to do with a pipeline someone changed after its last deploy (`heal` only in development)

onGateFail.description: what a failed smoke gate does: `none` leaves the stage as deployed; `rollback` replays the newest applied deployment of this bundle and target
